errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories on the horizontal axis are sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in ascending order of the percentage range they represent (None, Up to 10%, Over 10 to 25%, etc.).

errors.text_span: като са видими маркировки за 10%, 20%, 30% и т.н., въпреки че точните стойности на осите не са изписани
errors.evidence: The description claims there are visible tick marks on the vertical axis for values like 10%, 20%, 30%. The chart image shows no tick marks or labels on the vertical axis.
The description states the legend is in the top right corner, but it is located in the top center of the chart.
